Spotlight Draw.name: Spotlight Draw
Spotlight Draw.description: The user steps into full view on purpose and gives the crowd and cameras a show: a pose, a speech, a name to chant. While the user holds the spotlight, onlookers and press cameras miss whatever happens out of frame, such as a teammate's approach, a quiet arrest or an accomplice slipping away, and no phone footage of it spreads; fixed security cameras still record. Cost: none.
